title: City of Millbrook Water
summary: A mid-size city water department (surface-water treatment plant with chemical feed, wells, three storage tanks, four pump stations, SCADA with vendor remote access) and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: chemical-feed setpoint tampering through vendor remote access.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. The City of Millbrook, its people, vendors and identifiers are simulated.

scenarios.title: pH on the Edge
scenarios.summary: A vendor remote-support session on the Chemical Building HMI raises the caustic dose setpoint at night; the operator, the hard-wired pH trip and the grab samples disagree with the screen, and the department must go to manual, isolate the control network and decide on a Do Not Drink notice.
